title: VN Dialect API v1: index.json
description: One search record per entry. Search by folding the query (lowercase, strip tone and vowel marks, đ -> d) and matching it against `forms`, `keys`, `id` (Telex), `standard` and `gloss_words`; see docs/api.md.

id.description: Telex form of the spelling: fetch entries/<id>.json.

forms.description: Spelling, display heads and alternative forms.

keys.description: `forms` folded: no tone or vowel marks, lowercase (mắc -> mac).

standard.description: Standard-Vietnamese words this entry stands for (reverse lookup: đắt -> mắc).

gloss.description: Vietnamese gloss of the preview sense: the first sense that has one. Missing when no sense has a Vietnamese gloss.

gloss_en.description: English gloss of the same preview sense (the first sense when no sense has a Vietnamese gloss). Missing when that sense has none, so it never describes another meaning than `gloss`.

gloss_words.description: Distinct words of every sense's Vietnamese and English gloss, lowercase NFC with marks kept: search by meaning.

regions.description: Regions of the senses plus every region above them (mekong-delta also gives south), so a facet finds the same entries as regions/<id>.json.

status.description: Best verification status among the senses.
